full_name: Juliet B. Schor | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor Boston College
bio: Juliet B. Schor is a professor of sociology at Boston College (BC) and a member of the MacArthur Foundation–supported Connected Learning Research Network. Schor’s research focuses on issues of time use, consumption, and environmental sustainability.
